110-SECOND GUIDED INVESTIGATION

Record both target times and check solid plus dissolved sugar equals 10 g in each cell. The solubility table is approximate; temperature-sensitive transfer parameters are chosen teaching assumptions, not calibrated physical times.

Ideal baths hold pre-equilibrated temperatures fixed. Jacket colours identify setpoints, not a solved thermal field. During the experiment the guide advances 2.25 model seconds per second; manual playback is 1×. Chosen rates are not calibrated physical times.
